package.title: Tempo.Blazor.AI
package.description: AI conversation components for Tempo.Blazor: a safe Markdig markdown view, messages with citations and feedback, a streaming conversation container, a composer and tool-call/reasoning panels. Generic contracts live in Tempo.Blazor.Abstractions, so no LLM SDK is referenced.

gettingStarted.title: Tempo.Blazor.AI
gettingStarted.overview: AI conversation components for Tempo.Blazor: a safe Markdig markdown view, messages with citations and feedback, a streaming conversation container, a composer and tool-call/reasoning panels. Generic contracts live in Tempo.Blazor.Abstractions, so no LLM SDK is referenced.

items.description: One turn of an AI conversation (a user prompt or the model's answer): the ordered parts rendered through the safe markdown view, the citation chips with a source preview, the source cards, the follow-up chips and the action toolbar (copy as plain text, regenerate with a version switcher, thumbs up/down with an optional reason, read aloud). The bubble mirrors itself for a user turn, and the three lifecycle states read differently: streaming streams with the package caret and marks the body busy, stopped shows a localized label, failed shows the error with Retry.

parameters.name: ActionsTemplate
parameters.description: Replaces the whole built-in action toolbar with host actions. The built-in bar is a role=toolbar with a roving tabindex; a host template owns its own keyboard model, so it is rendered as plain content and must provide one if it renders more than one button.

parameters.name: ActiveVersionIndexChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the target zero-based version index when the reader steps through the regenerated versions. The component shows the chosen version immediately but never mutates AiMessage.ActiveVersionIndex: assign the index in the handler to persist the choice, and a host that changes the model's index itself wins over the reader's last step.

parameters.name: AvatarTemplate
parameters.description: Replaces the default role glyph inside the avatar slot. The slot itself stays decorative (aria-hidden): the role is conveyed by the message's own accessible structure, so a host image here must not introduce a second name for the same turn.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class(es) for the root element.

parameters.name: Message
parameters.description: The message this block renders. Required: a null value renders an empty shell (the body is empty and no action is offered) instead of throwing, so a host can place the component before the first token arrives.

parameters.name: OnCitationClick
parameters.description: Raised with the source id when a citation chip is activated — after the built-in source preview opened, so a host can navigate away without losing the preview state it never sees.

parameters.name: OnFeedback
parameters.description: Raised with the rating when the reader presses a thumb. A negative rating is raised immediately (thumbs up/down must never require an explanation) and raised a second time with AiFeedback.Reason when the reader submits the optional reason.

parameters.name: OnFollowUp
parameters.description: Raised with the suggestion text when a follow-up chip is activated.

parameters.name: OnRegenerate
parameters.description: Raised when the reader asks for another generation of this answer. The action renders only when a handler is bound, so no host gets a button that does nothing.

parameters.name: OnRetry
parameters.description: Raised when the reader asks to retry a failed generation.

parameters.name: ReadAloud
parameters.description: Offer the "Read aloud" action, which speaks the answer's plain text through the browser's speechSynthesis. Default false. The action is hidden when the browser has no speech synthesis (feature-detected on first render) — never a dead button.

parameters.name: ShowActions
parameters.description: Render the action toolbar (copy, regenerate, read aloud, feedback). Default true; the bar itself is offered only for a finished turn (completed, stopped or failed), because there is nothing to copy, regenerate or rate while the answer is still arriving.

parameters.name: ShowAvatar
parameters.description: Render the avatar slot (the role glyph, or AvatarTemplate). Default true.

parameters.name: ShowFollowUps
parameters.description: Render the follow-up suggestions as chips under the answer. Default true.

parameters.name: ShowSources
parameters.description: Render the cited sources as cards in part order. Default true.

examples.title: Render an assistant answer with actions
examples.code:
<TmAiMessage Message="@answer"
             OnRegenerate="@(() => candidates.RegenerateAsync(answer.Id))"
             OnFeedback="@(feedback => client.RateAsync(answer.Id, feedback))"
             OnCitationClick="@(id => sourcePanel.Open(answer.FindSource(id)))" />

examples.title: A regenerated answer with a version switcher, follow-ups and read-aloud
examples.code:
<TmAiMessage Message="@answer"
             ReadAloud="true"
             OnFollowUp="@(text => composer.SubmitAsync(text))"
             ActiveVersionIndexChanged="@(index => answer.ActiveVersionIndex = index)" />

items.description: Renders untrusted markdown (an AI answer, a tool result, a system note) through the package's safe pipeline: raw HTML is escaped instead of rendered, only http/https/mailto and relative link targets survive (everything else collapses to '#'), images are limited to absolute http(s), every link carries target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow", code blocks get a copy affordance and cite: links become citation chips that raise OnCitationClick. The rendered HTML is cached against the last input, so a parent re-render with unchanged text does not re-run Markdig.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class(es) for the root element.

parameters.name: CodeBlockTemplate
parameters.description: Optional host renderer for a code block, replacing the built-in <pre><code> plus copy affordance (for example with syntax-highlighted markup). The returned HTML is trusted verbatim, so the host owns its escaping: pass context.Code through HtmlEncoder.Default.Encode. Pass a stable reference — a cached field, a static method or a method group — because the render cache compares the delegate's Method and Target, not the delegate instance.

parameters.name: Markdown
parameters.description: The markdown to render. It is untrusted model output: the component renders it through the safe markdown pipeline (raw HTML disabled, http/https/mailto/relative allowlist, hardened links), so a hostile answer cannot execute markup. Tables become a keyboard-reachable named region and code blocks get a keyboard-reachable scroller plus a copy button that announces through a live region.

parameters.name: OnCitationClick
parameters.description: Raised with the source id when a citation chip is activated, so the host can open the source preview (the chips are rendered for markdown links written as [1](cite:<sourceId>)).

items.description: Extension methods for registering the Tempo.Blazor AI component group.

members.name: AddTempoBlazorAI
members.description: Registers the services required by the AI conversation components. Also calls AddTempoBlazor(). The AI model and streaming contracts live in Tempo.Blazor.Abstractions (Tempo.Blazor.AI.Models / .Services), so no LLM SDK is pulled in; the only third-party dependency is Markdig, behind AiMarkdownRenderer.

items.description: One code block handed to AiMarkdownRenderOptions.CodeBlockRenderer (the CodeBlockTemplate seam of TmMarkdownView): its index, its raw decoded code (the host escapes it) and the fence language.

members.name: Code
members.description: The raw code, decoded and not HTML-escaped; the renderer must escape it.

members.name: Index
members.description: Zero-based index of the code block in the document.

members.name: Language
members.description: The fence info string (csharp, json, …), or null for an indented block.

items.description: The safe markdown pipeline behind TmMarkdownView: Markdig with raw HTML disabled, an explicit URL allowlist (http/https/mailto plus relative targets, everything else collapses to '#'), images limited to absolute http(s), links hardened with target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow", code blocks with a copy affordance and a keyboard-reachable <pre>, tables wrapped in a keyboard-reachable named region and cite: links turned into citation chips. Registered by AddTempoBlazorAI() through TryAddSingleton, so a host may replace it with a subclass.

members.name: Render
members.description: Renders untrusted markdown to safe HTML.

items.description: Localized labels and host seams for AiMarkdownRenderer — the code-block copy/copied labels, the citation chip's accessible name, the scrollable table region's name (TableLabel) and the optional CodeBlockRenderer that takes over a code block (for example with syntax-highlighted markup). The renderer never invents user-visible text: TmMarkdownView supplies every label from ITmLocalizer.

members.name: CitationLabelFormat
members.description: Accessible name of a citation chip; {0} is the citation text, e.g. 1.

members.name: CodeBlockRenderer
members.description: Optional host renderer for a code block. When set, the built-in markup (including the copy affordance) is replaced by the returned HTML, which the renderer trusts verbatim — the host owns escaping and must treat its own output as trusted markup.

members.name: CopiedLabel
members.description: Accessible name and status text after the code was copied.

members.name: CopyCodeLabel
members.description: Accessible name of the copy button of a code block that has no language.

members.name: CopyCodeWithLanguageLabel
members.description: Accessible name of the copy button of a language-labelled code block; {0} is the language.

members.name: TableLabel
members.description: Accessible name of the scrollable table region. A table wider than the conversation column scrolls inside its wrapper, so the wrapper is a keyboard focus stop and a named role="region"; with a null or empty label the wrapper keeps its focus stop but omits the role (an unnamed landmark cannot be identified in a screen reader's landmark list).

items.description: The plain-text projection of an AI answer (ToPlainText): markdown markers are dropped while the block structure survives, so a copied or spoken answer reads like the answer instead of like its source. Link and image targets never travel — only their label (or alt text) — and the walk runs over the same safe Markdig pipeline the renderer uses, so raw HTML stays literal text.

members.name: ToPlainText
members.description: Projects untrusted markdown to readable plain text: one line per paragraph, list item (with a plain bullet or its number), code line and table row, blank lines between blocks, and '\n' line endings. Null or whitespace projects to an empty string.
